story.title: Decades of Dental Excellence, Compassionate Care
story.p1: At Redesign Dental Clinics, we believe every patient deserves personalized, ethical, and pain-free dental treatments. Our state-of-the-art facility in Banjara Hills is equipped with advanced digital diagnostics and world-standard sterilization protocols.
story.p2: Under the guidance of top prosthodontists and implantologists, our multi-specialty team delivers lasting smile transformations in a warm, anxiety-free setting.

services.title: Comprehensive Dental Care, Designed Around You
services.subtitle: From routine preventive checkups to complex oral surgery, we provide a complete spectrum of specialist dental care.

service.rootCanal.name: Root Canal Treatment
service.rootCanal.desc: Single-visit pain-free root canal treatment using rotary endodontics and digital apex locators.
service.endodonticRetreatment.name: Endodontic Retreatment
service.endodonticRetreatment.desc: Specialized microscopic care to save teeth with previous root canal infections.
service.endodonticSurgery.name: Endodontic Surgery (Apicoectomy)
service.endodonticSurgery.desc: Microsurgical treatment to remove infection from the root tip while saving the natural tooth.
service.teethCleaning.name: Teeth Cleaning & Polishing
service.teethCleaning.desc: Ultrasonic scaling and prophylactic polishing to remove tartar, plaque, and surface stains.
service.teethWhitening.name: Teeth Whitening & Smile Makeover
service.teethWhitening.desc: In-office LED laser whitening delivering up to 8 shades brighter in a single 45-minute session.
service.teethReshaping.name: Teeth Reshaping & Contouring
service.teethReshaping.desc: Subtle enamel recontouring to smooth minor chips, overlaps, and irregular tooth edges.
service.bonding.name: Composite Tooth Bonding
service.bonding.desc: Seamless tooth-colored resin bonding to repair chips, fractures, and close small gaps.
service.fillings.name: Composite Fillings & Sealants
service.fillings.desc: Durable, biocompatible tooth-colored restorations for cavities and preventive fissure sealants.
service.checkups.name: Comprehensive Dental Check-up
service.checkups.desc: Complete oral examination including digital X-rays, intraoral camera scans, and cancer screening.
service.cosmeticProcedures.name: Cosmetic Smile Makeover
service.cosmeticProcedures.desc: Customized digital smile design combining veneers, gum contouring, and aesthetic alignment.
service.dentalImplants.name: Dental Implants & Fixed Teeth
service.dentalImplants.desc: Permanent titanium and zirconia implants for single, multiple, or full-arch tooth replacement.
service.allOn4.name: All-on-4 & Full Arch Implants
service.allOn4.desc: Same-day fixed full-arch teeth supported by four to six precision-angled implants.
service.denturesBridges.name: Dentures & Fixed Bridges
service.denturesBridges.desc: Precision-crafted porcelain bridges and flexible natural-feeling full and partial dentures.
service.fullMouthRehab.name: Full Mouth Rehabilitation
service.fullMouthRehab.desc: Comprehensive functional and aesthetic restoration for worn, broken, or missing teeth.
service.extractions.name: Painless Tooth Extractions
service.extractions.desc: Gentle, minimally invasive extractions for non-restorable or severely decayed teeth.
service.wisdomTooth.name: Wisdom Tooth Surgery
service.wisdomTooth.desc: Precision surgical extraction of impacted third molars with minimal swelling and rapid healing.
service.oralSurgery.name: Minor Oral Surgery
service.oralSurgery.desc: Frenectomy, cyst enucleation, pre-prosthetic surgery, and soft tissue biopsy procedures.
service.laserDentistry.name: Laser Dentistry
service.laserDentistry.desc: Soft-tissue laser therapies for painless gum sculpting, ulcer healing, and depigmentation.
service.gumTreatment.name: Periodontal Gum Disease Treatment
service.gumTreatment.desc: Comprehensive treatment for bleeding gums, gingivitis, and chronic periodontitis.
service.gumGrafting.name: Gum Grafting & Recession Treatment
service.gumGrafting.desc: Microsurgical tissue grafting to restore receded gumlines and protect exposed tooth roots.
service.nonSurgicalPerio.name: Non-Surgical Periodontal Therapy
service.nonSurgicalPerio.desc: Deep antimicrobial irrigation, localized antibiotic placement, and laser pocket disinfection.
service.pocketReduction.name: Periodontal Pocket Reduction
service.pocketReduction.desc: Corrective periodontal surgery to reduce deep bacterial pockets and stabilize tooth support.
service.scalingRootPlaning.name: Deep Scaling & Root Planing
service.scalingRootPlaning.desc: Thorough subgingival debridement to smooth root surfaces and promote gum reattachment.
service.ridgePreservation.name: Socket & Ridge Preservation
service.ridgePreservation.desc: Bone grafting placed immediately after extraction to maintain jawbone volume for implants.
service.preventiveCare.name: Preventive Care & Fluoride Therapy
service.preventiveCare.desc: High-concentration topical fluoride varnish and remineralization treatments against decay.
service.mouthGuards.name: Night Guards & Sports Mouthguards
service.mouthGuards.desc: Custom-molded protective guards for bruxism (teeth grinding) and athletic protection.
service.digitalXray.name: Digital OPG & Intraoral X-Rays
service.digitalXray.desc: Ultra-low radiation high-resolution digital radiovisiography and panoramic imaging.
service.emergencyCare.name: Emergency Dental Care
service.emergencyCare.desc: Same-day priority treatment for severe toothache, broken teeth, trauma, and acute infections.
service.painManagement.name: Dental Pain Management
service.painManagement.desc: Immediate diagnostic evaluation and fast-acting therapeutic relief for acute dental pain.
service.toothacheRelief.name: Immediate Toothache Relief
service.toothacheRelief.desc: Targeted diagnostic testing and emergency pulpotomy or dressing for rapid comfort.
service.sedation.name: Sedation Dentistry & Anesthesia
service.sedation.desc: Nitrous oxide conscious sedation and oral sedatives for anxiety-free dental appointments.
service.pediatricCare.name: Pediatric Dental Care
service.pediatricCare.desc: Child-friendly dental checkups, sealants, pulpotomies, space maintainers, and gentle care.
service.clearBraces.name: Clear & Invisible Aligners
service.clearBraces.desc: Custom transparent aligners for discreet, comfortable teeth straightening without metal wires.
service.veneers.name: Porcelain Veneers & Laminates
service.veneers.desc: Ultra-thin custom porcelain shells bonded to the front teeth for flawless smile aesthetics.
service.crownsBridges.name: Zirconia & Ceramic Crowns
service.crownsBridges.desc: Metal-free CAD/CAM zirconia crowns providing life-like translucency and maximum strength.
service.tmjTreatment.name: TMJ & Jaw Pain Therapy
service.tmjTreatment.desc: Specialized diagnosis, splint therapy, and muscle relaxation for jaw clicking and TMD.
service.orthodontics.name: Traditional & Ceramic Braces
service.orthodontics.desc: Precision corrective orthodontics for misaligned bites, crowded teeth, and spacing issues.
why.title: Experience Dental Care With a Higher Standard
why.item1.title: Advanced 3D Digital Diagnostics
why.item1.desc: High-definition intraoral 3D scanning and digital X-rays with 90% less radiation for millimeter-precise treatment planning.
why.item2.title: Pain-Free Computerized Anesthesia
why.item2.desc: We use modern computerized delivery and fine micro-needles so your appointments are completely comfortable.
why.item3.title: Hospital-Grade Class-B Sterilization
why.item3.desc: Every instrument undergoes strict 6-step medical autoclaving and vacuum sealing for uncompromising patient hygiene.
why.item4.title: Transparent Pricing & Clear Treatment Plans
why.item4.desc: No hidden costs. We provide a detailed treatment estimate and explain every step before starting any procedure.

testimonials.title: Stories of Restored Smiles and Genuine Trust
testimonials.review1.text: I was terrified of getting a root canal, but Dr. Suhail and his team made the entire procedure completely painless. The clinic is ultra-modern and pristine.
testimonials.review1.author: Priya Sharma
testimonials.review2.text: The dental implant treatment I received at Redesign Dental Clinics was exceptional. Everything was explained clearly and the result feels just like my natural teeth.
testimonials.review2.author: Rajesh Varma
testimonials.review3.text: Best dental clinic in Banjara Hills. My smile makeover with veneers turned out better than I could have imagined. Highly recommend to everyone!
testimonials.review3.author: Sneha Reddy
